name: planka
summary: [Planka](https://github.com/plankanban/planka/) is an elegant open source project tracking tool.

volumes.description: Local path for planka config files.

env.name: BASE_URL
env.description: The URL you will use to access planka including protocol, and port if not 80/443.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Postgres database URL. Special characters must be [url encoded](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Percent-encoding).

env.name: SECRET_KEY
env.description: Session encryption key, recommended 32-64 character alphanumeric.

env.name: TRUST_PROXY
env.description: Set to `true` to trust upstream proxies if reverse proxying.

env.name: DEFAULT_LANGUAGE
env.description: This sets the default language for sending notifications per user (if a user hasn't selected a language) and per board.

docs.setup:
Web UI is accessible at http://SERVERIP:PORT. An external postgres database is required.

Once you've run your first time setup you can safely remove the DEFAULT_ environment variables. They will overwrite any changes made to the default user in the web UI (passwords, display names, etc.) on startup if left in place.

### Migration from Official Image

Copy your `user-avatars`, `background-images`, and `attachments` folders to your new `/config` mount so that it looks like:

```text
/config
├── attachments
└── images
    ├── background-images
    └── user-avatars
```

changelog.text: Rebase to Alpine 3.23. Updates for v2. Users should update `TRUST_PROXY` to use `true`/`false` instead of `1`/`0`.
